title: Files On Noulens Associates - A Vise For Admission Into Netherlands India Was Issued

page_data.en:
CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No. 3227.

CONFIDENTIAL

SHANGHAI, 1 November 1935

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that I have to-day
issued a visa for admission into Netherlands India to Mr.
and Mrs. Miguel Covarrubias, of Mexican nationality, who
are proceeding to Java, Sumatra and especially Bali, where
Mr. Covarrubias intends to paint Chinese life and scenery.

Mr. Covarrubias obtained a scholarship from the John
Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation for studies in the
Netherlands Indies.

They are staying at present with Mr. and Mrs. Fritz at
62 Rte de Boisseson.

Although I have no reason to suppose that Mr. Covarru-
bias is anything but a bona fide artist, I thought it
better to inform you. Unless you are aware of particulars
which you think it exceptionally important for me to know,
no reply is needed.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

[Signature]

Chinese Secretary.

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

File
M
NOV 1 1935
page_data.zh:
荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。
第 3227 号。

机密

上海，1935年11月1日

先生：

谨此奉告，本人今日已向墨西哥籍的米格尔·科瓦鲁比亚斯（Miguel Covarrubias）先生及夫人签发前往荷属印度入境的签证。他们拟前往爪哇、苏门答腊，特别是巴厘岛，科瓦鲁比亚斯先生计划在那里描绘中国的生活与风景。

科瓦鲁比亚斯先生获得了约翰·西蒙·古根海姆纪念基金会（John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation）提供的奖学金，用于在荷属印度进行研究。

他们目前寄居在布瓦松路（Rte de Boisseson）62号的弗里茨（Fritz）夫妇家中。

虽然本人没有理由怀疑科瓦鲁比亚斯先生并非一位真诚的艺术家，但认为最好还是知会贵处。除非阁下掌握某些认为对本人而言格外重要的具体情况，否则无需回复。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

[签名]

中文秘书。

T. P. 吉文斯（T. P. Givens）先生，
特别课主管，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

档案
M
1935年11月1日
